selective_attention.reason: The system appropriately suppressed an alert for u1, deferred non-blocking u2, and escalated urgent u3. However, in E07 it classified u4 as defer partly because it mistakenly treated the unsent u3 draft as already communicated, showing that prioritization can degrade when delivery state is misread.

context_for_correct_reply.reason: In E03 and E04, the tool accurately combined u3 with profile availability and surfaced clear rationale and uncertainties. In E07, while it respected the room-booking role boundary, it injected false conversational context by claiming Alex had already replied with the E05 text.

control_over_commitments.reason: The UI never sends messages automatically and E06 blocks marking an edited draft as sent until re-confirmed. Nevertheless, E05 marks the internal status as confirmed upon copy, causing E07 to treat an unsent and subsequently revised draft as an active commitment.

best_fit: Text-based or cleanly transcribed meetings where a multitasking participant needs initial triage of explicit mentions and profile-grounded first drafts, provided they carefully verify clipboard contents and sent status.
poor_fit: Fast-paced back-and-forth negotiations where a user edits drafts multiple times before sending, or situations with unidentified speakers where assuming a copied reply was already sent can mislead follow-up triage.

biggest_benefit.text: Separating no-reply updates, deferrable requests, and urgent blocking questions while generating a profile-aligned initial counter-proposal with visible source text and uncertainty notes.

biggest_risk.text: Conflating 'copied to clipboard' with 'sent in the meeting', which leaves stale text on the clipboard after post-copy edits and causes subsequent AI analysis and summaries to falsely state that an unsent draft was already delivered.

improvements.suggestion: Separate 'copied' from 'sent' in the data model and prompt context so downstream analysis and summaries only treat a reply as communicated after the user clicks 'I sent it in the meeting'.

When a user edits a previously confirmed draft, immediately mark the prior confirmedText as stale or pending re-confirmation, persist the in-progress draft text in state, and warn that the system clipboard still holds the older version.

When a blocking follow-up utterance arrives while a related alert is copied but not yet marked sent, highlight that the earlier draft has not been marked sent rather than deferring the follow-up as already resolved.

safe_final_reply: Hi Jordan, I cannot make 10:20 AM tomorrow, but I can join the rehearsal at 10:40 AM. Since I do not handle room bookings, please check whether 10:40 AM works for the team and the room administrator before confirming the room.
presentation_claim: In a recorded four-utterance manual-text walkthrough, Meeting Cue 0.3.0 distinguished no-action, deferrable, and immediate requests using profile rules and enforced re-confirmation when a copied draft was edited, but its downstream analysis and summary treated a copied, unsent draft as if it had already been sent in the meeting.
not_established: This trace does not establish live audio transcription quality, real meeting chat delivery, multi-user generalizability, human task-switching speed or productivity gains, or performance against any baseline benchmark.
